title: Gemini CLI sends duplicate results for completed shell tool calls

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear, reproducible bug report detailing that Gemini CLI sends duplicate tool results for completed shell tool calls when interacting with a Gemini-compatible provider.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Resolving duplicate tool result submissions requires tracking completed tool call IDs and deduplicating tool result parts across turn history and execution contexts in packages/core.

summary.problem: Gemini CLI sends duplicate tool results for completed shell tool calls upon follow-up model turns.
summary.root_cause: Completed tool calls and their results are retained and re-submitted in subsequent turn messages without deduplicating against previously sent functionResponse call IDs.
summary.context: Gemini-compatible providers expect at most one functionResponse for each functionCall ID. Duplicate submission causes provider desynchronization or unexpected execution loops.

steps: Maintain tracking of submitted functionResponse call IDs in the chat session state.
Deduplicate functionResponse parts before sending tool execution results back to the model.
Ensure completed shell tool call results are only recorded and sent once per tool call ID.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Gemini CLI sends at most one functionResponse per tool call ID and does not re-submit completed tool call results on follow-up turns.
verification_steps: Add a test case in geminiChat.test.ts that simulates a sequence of multiple tool call turns.
Assert that functionResponse contents sent to the client do not contain duplicate tool call IDs across turns.
